name: ssworld
description: Author, compile, render and inspect SSDL 3D geographic scenes on the SSEngine WebGPU runtime. Use when the user wants a 3D scene, digital twin, building, city block, geographic layout or interactive 3D object built, edited or previewed as a real-time 3D world.

interface.shortDescription: Build 3D scenes and see the frame
interface.longDescription: SSWorld lets the agent write a scene in SSDL, render it on a real WebGPU engine, and read the rendered frame back as pixel statistics — luma percentiles, exposure tails, colour coverage per region, and the camera pose actually used. It can therefore judge and fix its own output instead of guessing.
defaultPrompt: Build me a dusk city block and show me the frame
